title.narrative: APPLYING CITYRAP WITHIN THE CONTEXT OF THE PROJECT “STRENGTHENING THE ADAPTIVE CAPACITY AND CLIMATE RESILIENCE OF GUINEA-BISSAU VULNERABLE COASTAL COMMUNITIES TO CLIMATE RISKS”

description.narrative: The project aims to guide the technical assistance to be provided by the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) to the Government of Guinea-Bissau, through the Ministry of the Environment, in collaboration with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), within the context of the implementation of the Project “Strengthening the adaptive capacity and climate resilience of Guinea-Bissau vulnerable coastal communities to climate risks”. The focus on coastal areas is justified by their high exposure and vulnerability to climate risks, which requires urgent action for the establishment of policy and institutional frameworks through participatory, inclusive, and bottom-up approaches to build their resilience in a manner that adequately responds to the challenges and potential of these communities. The intervention will contemplate four sectors (sub-national administrative division). The technical assistance will be given by trough the application of CityRAP tool. CityRAP is a participatory planning tool used for training and building the capacity of city managers, municipal technicians, and key urban stakeholders to plan actions aimed at reducing risk and building resilience against natural and other hazards in the city. It targets small to medium sized cities in developing countries with an urban population size of maximum 250,000 people. CityRAP will be applied within Component 1 of the umbrella project, contemplating activities that will support the fulfilment of the following Outcomes: • Outcome 1: Government officials and relevant stakeholders at the sector level are knowledgeable and capable to operationalise processes of resilience action planning. • Outcome 2: Resilience-building interventions in the sectors of São Domingos, Bubaque, Mansoa and Cascine follow an evidence and participatory input-based framework. • Outcome 3: Integrated action between the governments of the sectors of São Domingos, Bubaque, Mansoa and Cacine in building resilience in coastal areas in Guinea-Bissau is strengthened.
